Here's what Samarawickrama has to say: "When I went to bat it was not easy at all. We 
really struggled to get runs but Pathum and Kusal gave us a good start. I just wanted to 
go there and rotate strike and keep the momentum for the side. It was really hard to 
play shots so I planned to play late. I think spinners were more challenging. I think the 
past few days it was raining so the wicket was raining so that's the reason it's a bit 
slow. Really happy [with the score]. It's not a 280-300 kind of a pitch." 
6.45pm A whirlwind knock from Samarawickrama, who raced away to a career best 72-
ball 93 has helped Sri Lanka power through to 257. It seemed to be a slow pitch and 
even though it was the Bangladesh pacers who did all the damage, it was hard to get 
the spinners away. Taskin Ahmed and Hasan Mahmud took three each, while Shoriful 
chipped in with two crucial wickets in consecutive overs to get rid of the well set 
Nissanka and Kusal Mendis (who also scored a fifty). Sri Lanka looked in trouble at that 
point, but Samarawickrama's knock ensured Sri Lanka go into the break with the 
momentum. Join Madushka in around 20 minutes for the chase!
